prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce one isolated Stone Age game building sprite. Attached image 1 (hut) and image 2 (camp scene) are locked style anchors: closely match their fine controlled dark ink contours, sparse interior linework, restrained natural earth-tone wash, two-tone upper-left illumination. Orthographic vertically overhead camera with only a slight front-face cheat, no isometric perspective. Uniform solid pure #FF00FF magenta backdrop everywhere outside the object, including holes. No extraneous surrounding ground apron, cast shadow, text, labels, people, photo, 3D rendering, pixel art, gradients, modern objects, or metal. Center with margin, crisp edges. South is bottom of image. A wide 2x1-tile primitive woodworking bench from a split log on two wooden trestles, a stone adze and short worked branch on top, open accessible working side at south. Dominant horizontal orientation. No metal, nails, modern vise or ground patch.
